name: MonarchProgressViewStyle
title: Progress
summary: A linear progress bar in Monarch's colours for the standard ProgressView, determinate or indeterminate.
whenToUse: For progress with a known fraction, or a wait of unknown length that belongs to a region of the screen.
whenNotToUse: For a spinner, use the standard circular ProgressView.

options.name: tone
options.description: The colour of the fill: the accent, or a status tone for a meter. Say what the tone means in the label too.

options.name: size
options.description: The thickness of the bar: .md is 8 points, .sm is 4 points, as the web.

states.name: determinate
states.description: The fill covers the completed fraction, limited to 0 through 1.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: A segment moves along the track; it stays still when Reduce Motion is on.

appearance: A muted track with a fill in the accent colour, in every theme.
platformNotes: Android wraps Material 3 LinearProgressIndicator. Stacked segments and quota meters from the web Progress are not offered yet.
accessibility: The label, the bar and the value label are one element whose value is the percentage in the user's locale.
The element has the updates-frequently trait.
The indeterminate animation stops when Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: A value above the total draws a full bar.
A not-a-number fraction draws an empty bar.

examples.title: Determinate and indeterminate
examples.template:
VStack(spacing: 12) {
    ProgressView(value: {{bars.0.value}}, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear(tone: {{bars.0.tone|tone}}, size: {{bars.0.size|case}}))
        .accessibilityLabel({{bars.0.label}})
    ProgressView(value: {{bars.1.value}}, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear(tone: {{bars.1.tone|tone}}, size: {{bars.1.size|case}}))
        .accessibilityLabel({{bars.1.label}})
    ProgressView()
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear(tone: {{bars.2.tone|tone}}, size: {{bars.2.size|case}}))
        .accessibilityLabel({{bars.2.label}})
}
examples.code:
VStack(spacing: 12) {
    ProgressView(value: 40, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear(tone: .accent, size: .md))
        .accessibilityLabel("Upload progress")
    ProgressView(value: 100, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear(tone: .success, size: .sm))
        .accessibilityLabel("Import progress")
    ProgressView()
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear(tone: .accent, size: .md))
        .accessibilityLabel("Syncing members")
}

parityExceptions.reason: The third bar is indeterminate: its segment sweeps along the track, so a screenshot catches it at any position; the web image shows it at the start. With Reduce Motion on, the segment stays at the start as on the web.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG Motion: indeterminate progress animates, and stops with Reduce Motion
